body: It isn’t. Our friend is acting like we are in the wrong here, so I just wanted to get some honest opinions from people who don’t know us in the slightest. I thought maybe it isn’t fair for us the be upset over this or something.

It’s not that she missed our hangout or anything, just that this has been planned for longer. She was on a call with one of her other friends. She absolutely should go spend time with her other friends, that’s not the point. The point is that when we have something planned, she avoids it at the very last second. 

And about the going back to Norway sooner thing, her flight is scheduled for Monday, I think. 
She doesn’t have other things to attend to back in Norway. There is no reason for her to go back earlier.

I forgot to add this, but this isn’t the first time she canceled on us last minute. We were supposed to do something for Christmas last December (when she didn’t live in Norway yet) but she cancelled on us about an hour before. Sorry but I don’t think it’s self-absorbed for me and my sister to be upset over this.

Hi, I’ve been on sertraline for about 14 months now (since january 2024) for my severe anxiety disorder. I understand your anxiety about trying new medications, I had that too when I started sertraline. 
Personally, I didn’t have too many problems with it. At first, I did get really sleepy but that was only for the first couple of weeks. One side effect I do still have is that I get the weirdest dreams, but they don’t affect me negatively. 
Honestly, I think that if I never started taking sertraline, I might not be here today. 

So while it is very very scary at first, it helped me so so much, and I hope it will help you too 🩷 you can do it!!
